summary.text: Framing a natural continuation that confirms the restaurant stays Mario's on Pine Street while allowing a time change and adding casual small talk.

content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Devon: hey you still awake
Devon: just got home and my cat is already judging me
Me: lol yeah I'm up, folding laundry finally
Devon: the clean load yours is sitting on?
Me: exactly, had to evict her twice
Devon: mine was screaming when I walked in, gave her food and now she's ignoring me
Me: classic, they only love us when they're hungry
Devon: fr, did you eat yet
Me: nah was gonna heat up that lemon pepper chicken from the freezer
Devon: oh the stuff from last week?
Me: yeah figured I should use it before it gets freezer burn
Devon: smart, I had leftover nuggets for lunch so I'm kinda snacky now
Me: you always have the randomest dinners lol
Devon: hey nuggets are a food group
Me: no argument here
Devon: how was work today, still crazy?
Me: eh not bad, just a lot of emails. you?
Devon: boss is out so it was actually quiet for once
Me: oh nice, enjoy that while it lasts
Devon: I know right, no last minute chart hell
Me: thank god, those charts haunted you for weeks
Devon: don't remind me lol
Devon: traffic on 5th still stupid btw
Me: ugh by the bank again?
Devon: yep cones everywhere still
Me: I cut through by Oak today to avoid it
Devon: good call, I should've done that
Me: did your mom ever get her groceries sorted?
Devon: yeah we went last weekend, she's stocked now
Me: tell her I said hi
Devon: will do, she still brings up you and the potato salad
Me: lol I can't help it that stuff is elite
Devon: she said she's making it again soon so you're in luck
Me: okay now I'm actually hungry
Devon: save room, speaking of food
Devon: so about tomorrow
Me: yeah what's up
Devon: can we push Mario's from 6 pm to 7 pm instead?
Devon: I gotta stay like 30 mins late to cover something and 6 is gonna be tight
Me: oh yeah 7 works for me
Devon: you sure? I can still try to rush if you want to keep 6
Me: nah 7 is fine, I'll just leave a little later too
Devon: perfect thank you, Mario's on Pine Street still good?
Me: yep still craving those cheesy slices
Devon: same, I need something heavier than Rosa's thin crust last time
Me: that margherita was good tho
Devon: it was, but my team ordering from Mario's last week got me hooked
Me: way better than sad Domino's at 2pm lol
Devon: oh god anything's better than that
Me: did they ever try to do another Saturday team lunch?
Devon: nah everyone complained so they dropped it
Me: good, criminal timing
Devon: fr, so yeah 7 tomorrow, I'll text when I'm leaving the office
Me: sounds good, I'll do the same. parking in back right?
Devon: yeah I think there's parking in back
Me: cool, I'll aim for like right at 7
Devon: same, I'll grab a table if I'm first
Me: okay I'm gonna go nuke this chicken now
Devon: enjoy your fancy freezer dinner lol
Me: hey it's better than cereal
Devon: low blow, cereal is elite
Me: lol night, see you at 7 tomorrow
Devon: night!",
  "writer_note": "Kept the time-change as a small work-delay request inside normal evening catch-up about cats, laundry, traffic, and leftovers, with explicit 6pm-to-7pm move and confirmation that Mario's on Pine Street stays the plan."
}
